title: SUNAT catalog
description: One SUNAT catálogo (or Perunio-internal enum). Editors validate against this live; validate.mjs re-checks it plus the rules JSON Schema cannot express (cross-catalog references, uniform entry shape, capability vocabulary).

id.description: Stable identifier. Drives every generated symbol and the package export subpath: `cat07` yields CAT07_CODES, Cat07Code, sunat-catalogs/cat07.

sunatCatalog.description: The SUNAT catálogo number as printed in the anexo ('07', '51'). null for Perunio-internal enums.

name.description: Human name, used in generated doc comments.

source.description: Where the data came from. Cite the resolución or the checked-in file under perunio-facturador/resources/ — never 'the frontend had this list'.

codePattern.description: Regex every code must match. Anchored.

goConsts.description: Emit a named Go constant per entry (default true). Set false on a large geographic or reference dataset where one constant per row would be noise; the map, Codes slice and lookups are still generated. Entries in such a file omit goName.

propRefs.description: Declares which props are cross-catalog references: { "taxSchemeCode": "cat05" }. validate.mjs resolves them; the generators type them.

code.description: The wire value, always a string: '0', '01', '1000', 'NIU'.

label.description: Short Spanish label for pickers, badges and table cells.

description.description: SUNAT's own full wording. May equal label.

capabilities.description: Tokens from meta/capabilities.json. 'display' is implicit — do not write it.

flags.description: Booleans only. Every entry in a file must carry the same keys.

props.description: Scalars and cross-catalog code references. Every entry in a file must carry the same keys; defaults are materialised, absent values are explicit null.

goName.description: Suffix of the generated Go constant: 'GravadoOnerosa' yields Cat07GravadoOnerosa. Set it to preserve the name the Go code already uses.
